reference.note: Reference confirms the supported learning components; its grade does not validate factual accuracy.

rendererSupport.unknownBlockBehavior: Renderer falls through to paragraph-like presentation; TypeScript casts do not validate imported JSON at runtime.

classificationMeaning.A: Structurally ready under heuristics; factual/depth review still required.
classificationMeaning.B: Missing important learning support or showing short/repetitive/generic signals.
classificationMeaning.C: Severe schema, accessibility, missing-data, or sparsity problem.

caveats: Block count and text length do not establish factual accuracy.
Warning is contextual and is not required for every lesson.
An embedded concrete example can be sufficient without a separate example block.
Japanese technical terms can legitimately appear in Vietnamese text; mostly-Japanese detection is only a review signal.
Exact-duplicate detection finds reuse, not plagiarism or factual error.

doNotForceBlocks: Do not add warning unless a concrete misconception, exception, risk, or exam trap exists.
Do not split an already-clear embedded example solely to satisfy a block count.
Do not copy summary into point or term definitions to fill fields.
Consider merging an overly narrow lesson before padding it with headings.

upgradePlan.target: C and severe data/runtime accessibility defects
High-importance B and missing core bilingual support
Other B: examples, depth, generic points, contextual warnings
Manual factual and pedagogical review of A
